dct_description_sm: Tunisia administrative level 0-4 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 4 levels: - Admin 1: 6 - Admin 2: 24 - Admin 3: 264 - Admin 4: 2084 Dates associated with this dataset: - 19 December 2024: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 15 November 2022: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 15 August 2022: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 15 August 2022: boundaries created by the source Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
dct_publisher_sm: Institut National de la Statistique Tunisie
